# Harbour archive opening night rehearsal

The harbour archive rehearsal looked calm until a speaker asked to remove an extract already printed on the wall. We can still change it. Write that into the invitation rather than treating consent as a hurdle cleared months ago. The curator is worried about the opening date; I am worried about the speaker feeling trapped by our timetable. [[Exhibition plan]] should name who can authorize a late removal.
